# PatientGain

> PatientGain is a HIPAA-compliant AI-powered marketing platform designed to help healthcare providers acquire and engage new patients through integrated digital marketing services.

PatientGain offers tiered service packages (GOLD, PLATINUM, PLATINUM Plus, and Enterprise) ranging from $299 to $1999+ per month, combining patient acquisition, SEO, social media automation, reputation management, and specialized apps like SPOC (Single Point of Conversion) for healthcare practices across the USA.

- GOLD Service Tier

- Google SEO
